questions.text: Aileen Wuornos — what was her primary method of killing?
questions.explanation: Aileen Wuornos was responsible for seven confirmed murders, all committed by shooting.

questions.text: Nannie Doss — what was her primary method of killing?
questions.explanation: Nannie Doss was known for poisoning victims, particularly members of her own family.

questions.text: Gary Ridgway — what was his primary method of killing?
questions.explanation: Gary Ridgway, known as the Green River Killer, primarily killed his victims by strangulation.

questions.text: Jack the Ripper — what was the primary method associated with the murders attributed to him?
questions.explanation: The murders attributed to Jack the Ripper involved extensive knife attacks and are most commonly associated with stabbing.

questions.text: David Berkowitz (Son of Sam) — what was his primary method of killing?
questions.explanation: David Berkowitz used a firearm in the shootings that became known as the Son of Sam murders.

questions.text: Harold Shipman — what was his primary method of killing?
questions.explanation: Harold Shipman killed his victims by administering lethal doses of drugs, particularly morphine.

questions.text: John Wayne Gacy — what was his primary method of killing?
questions.explanation: Most of John Wayne Gacy's victims were killed through asphyxiation, including strangulation.

questions.text: Jeffrey Dahmer — what was his primary method of killing?
questions.explanation: Jeffrey Dahmer primarily killed his victims through asphyxiation.

questions.text: Charles Cullen — what was his primary method of killing?
questions.explanation: Charles Cullen, a nurse, killed patients by administering excessive or inappropriate doses of medications.

questions.text: Pedro López — which method is most commonly associated with his confirmed killings?
questions.explanation: Pedro López was convicted of multiple murders involving stabbing, although accounts of his crimes describe more than one method.
